text_block_list.text: Ugh! How did I lose AGAIN?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Like, what's wrong with me? Not enough
grit?
Hard work? Luck? Am I just not cut
out for this?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And I said I was gonna become the "real
me."
God, I'm such a loser.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...No, you're right. I just don't want
everyone
thinking that racing is just my
side hustle.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But I also don't have the patience—I have to win the next race.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...Haha. If this were a modeling gig,
nobody
would ever suggest that not
caring how I look is
"my style."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But it's true—I've been such a loser. If I
carry on
like this, people are gonna stop
caring about me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Maybe a little panicking could do me
some good.
I'll train like hell, then prove
just how fast I can be
next race!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: And I won't be ignored. I'll win the next race and turn all their heads again!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
